nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values: A photograph of one young woman cosplaying as Princess Peach from the Super Mario franchise, lying on her side with her head resting on a pale pink pillow; she wears a short blonde wig with side-swept bangs and a curled tendril by her ear with a visible round blue earring, heavy black winged eyeliner, subtle natural makeup, fair skin with faint freckles, and a quiet, slightly longing gaze directed at the camera; her bare shoulders and upper chest are visible and her left arm appears in the foreground, creating an intimate, close-up selfie crop taken from a slightly elevated, top-down camera angle with shallow depth of field focused on her eyes and face; the scene is set against a dark, low-lit background lit by a single frontal flash or phone lamp that produces soft highlights on the skin and pillow and gentle shadows on the contours of her face; the pillow shows soft cotton wrinkles and the wig has visible synthetic fiber texture; include a centered caption near the bottom on a translucent black bar with white sans-serif text reading "I need you Mario".
